name: Car Parts International
old_description: For over 30 years, specialists in automotive repair have relied on International Car Parts and Car Parts International for foreign automotive parts.
about:
International Car Parts, operating as Car Parts International, is based in Needham, Massachusetts. The company has served the automotive repair market for more than 30 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been released. The business operates under the legal name International Car Parts, Imports LTD.

The company distributes original equipment and aftermarket parts for foreign vehicles. It maintains a fleet of delivery trucks to provide same-day service to customers in its region. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Its customer base consists primarily of automotive repair specialists who rely on the company for foreign car parts. The firm does not publicly list specific client names or industry segments beyond the general repair trade.

The company emphasizes its commitment to delivering the correct part on time, every time, and stands behind the quality of both its OE and aftermarket offerings. Its same-day delivery capability, supported by a company-owned fleet, is presented as a key differentiator.
